run_knn_evaluation: run k-NN classification evaluation on a DINOv3 model using train and test datasets
create_KnnModule: create a KnnModule to compute k-nearest neighbors on distributed chunks of train features
eval_knn_with_model: evaluate k-NN classification with a model, extracting train features and running test evaluation
